articles.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
articles.description: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

articles.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
articles.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

articles.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
articles.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians, health ministry says
articles.description: Witnesses say a missile hit a building containing the surgical wards and intensive care units at Nasser hospital, the largest in southern Gaza.

articles.title: Eight killed in Colombian air strike targeting Gulf Clan gang
articles.description: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.

articles.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
articles.description: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

articles.title: Fiery clashes erupt in Spain as millions join general strike
articles.description: Unrest broke out in cities across Spain on Wednesday after millions of workers joined the country's first general strike in 14 years.

articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six, health ministry says
articles.description: An Israeli airstrike on a Palestinian hospital has killed at least six and wounded 28, Gaza's Health Ministry said.
